inputs.description: List of input image strings in format 'type|file'. E.g. ['raw|image.dd']. For multiple inputs, add more entries.

input_opts.description: List of comma-separated inopts strings corresponding to each input. If input is single, this can be empty or single item.

morph.description: Morphing function to apply. See xmount --info for supported types. Empty string disables morphing if default is not wanted, but manpage says default is combine. We default to empty to let xmount use its own default, or set to 'combine'. Let's set default to empty string to imply 'use xmount default' if the template logic handles it. But the template renders `--morph`. If empty, it might render `--morph `. Better to default to empty and check in template, or default to a value. Manpage: defaults to combine. I will default to empty and update template to conditionally render.

morph_opts.description: List of morph opts strings to join with comma.

offset.description: Offset in bytes to move output image data start.

sizelimit.description: Data end limit in bytes. 0 means no limit.

output_format.description: Output image format (raw, dmg, vdi, vhd, vmdk, vmdks). Defaults to raw.

cache_file.description: Path to cache file for virtual write support. Empty disables.

mount_point.description: Mount point where virtual files should be located.
